description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Average', a marker for displaying the distance to dataset's average value in a graph, extending 'Image_Graph_Marker'. It includes a method '_drawMarker' to draw the marker on a canvas, connecting to dataset's average Y value.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Average
classes.description: A marker displaying the 'distance' to the datasets average value, extending 'Image_Graph_Marker'.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, connecting the point to the dataset's average Y value and drawing a small line at the average point.
